input.body: We are writing to request a review of a $15.00 deduction on order UE-tf03c, dated 2026-11-05, which was applied with the reason "missing item" (Garlic Naan). The order ticket for UE-tf03c lists Garlic Naan, so the item was part of the order as it was prepared [UE-tf03c:ticket_lists_item]. Our records show the order was ready at 20:33 and was picked up at 20:36, a handoff 3 minutes after it was ready [UE-tf03c:pickup_handoff]. We do not have evidence of what was in the bag after pickup, and we are stating only what our records show. Based on the ticket and the pickup timing, we ask that the deduction be reviewed and reversed. Thank you for your time and consideration.
